findings.F1: Step 5's result points against the idea, not just falls short of the bar: the mean unusual move over 7 days is -0.30 % per case (t -0.67, 854 case days, 1757 cases, strength -0.024 of a 12.44 % usual move), while the 3.1×-cost total move of +0.60 % comes entirely from the coins' normal drift of +0.91 %. On folds B and C the long cases (forecast ≥ 2, 383 cases on 120 days) give -0.39 % (cluster t -0.30) against drift and -0.85 % (t -0.65) against the window's own mean.
findings.F2: Per window the effect is mixed in sign and large in swing, so the market's own moves drown it: the cases' 7-day unusual move runs from -8.95 % in w7 (t -5.2) and -5.75 % in w12 (t -4.4) to +7.22 % in w11 (t 2.65). Per coin it is +2.18 % for XRP, -1.04 % for LTC and -0.77 % for ZEC, none with |t| above 0.9.
findings.F3: The grading the idea needs is not in the data at 7 days. On all grid bars with a scaled 3-day rise above 0 (421 cases), the slope of the 7-day unusual move on the scaled rise is 0.0013 (t 0.12) and the Spearman correlation is -0.08. Across scaled-rise quintiles the 7-day unusual move goes +0.95 %, -1.75 %, +1.38 %, +0.13 %, +0.26 %, with no rise toward the largest rallies.
findings.F4: What continuation there is sits in calm markets (30-day swing at or below its usual level, approximated inside each window) and at a longer horizon. Calm cases earn +1.44 % over 7 days (t 0.61, 39 days) and +7.13 % over 14 days (t 1.42, 35 days; +6.80 %, t 1.50, against the window mean). Agitated cases earn -0.65 % (t -0.23) and +0.10 % (t 0.03).
findings.F5: In calm markets the 14-day unusual move rises with the scaled 3-day rise across quintiles: -5.06 %, +2.78 %, -0.75 %, +4.17 %, +9.51 % (about 60 bars each). In agitated markets the top quintile is -3.13 % at 14 days. The linear slope in calm markets is still weak (t 0.44, 147 cases), so this is suggestive and short of clear.
findings.F6: By trend, the 7-day unusual move is positive in rising calm markets (+2.70 %, t 1.61, 75 cases) and in choppy calm ones (+5.96 %, t 1.90, 27). It is negative or flat in agitated choppy (-6.56 %, t -1.82) and agitated falling (-0.72 %) markets. The split again runs along agitation rather than trend.

ideas.idea: In a calm market, a coin whose 3-day return is large against its usual daily swing (the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days) keeps rising over the next 14 days, and the larger that scaled 3-day rise, the larger the further gain.
ideas.consequence: A trader would ride unusually large rallies only when the coin has been swinging less than usual, holding for two weeks, and would refuse the same rally in an agitated market.
ideas.name: calm-market rally two-week continuation
